identitySignals: Name match: the agenda's 'OBR Electric, LLC' matches 'OBR Electric Limited Liability Co', an electrical contractor in Oakland, CA (BBB profile, which lists California contractor license 1094999).

Business type match: OUSD's agreement is for site improvements at Montera Middle School, handled by Facilities. OBR Electric's website describes commercial and industrial electrical work in the East Bay.
Not confirmed: no California Secretary of State record, no OUSD or Montera mention, and no city in the agenda text. The match rests on the name and the type of work.

profile.summary: OBR Electric is an electrical contractor based in Oakland, California. It provides residential, commercial and industrial electrical services in the San Francisco Bay Area. These include service upgrades, electric vehicle charger installation and new construction work. The website says it has operated since 2015.
